name: helena-facebook
description:
Helena is your AI marketer for Facebook. Review connected profiles and supported posts, research content ideas, and draft posts in your brand voice. Publish content or manage your content calendar when you approve the action. Read public Page statistics such as followers, likes, and ratings; historical reach reports are not available through this connector.

Helena uses your saved business preferences and research to keep work relevant to your brand. Save drafts and reports in your workspace and review your content calendar. Publishing, scheduling, and spend changes require your approval.

Create images, video, and music; compose media; inspect existing assets; and transcribe audio.

Requires an Enrich Labs account with MCP access, a brand workspace, and a connected Facebook account with permission for the requested work.

capabilities: Read supported posts and publish approved social content
defaultPrompt: Show my connected Facebook publishing destinations.
Read recent Facebook posts; ask me for a profile or channel if needed.
Draft a Facebook product announcement and save it to my workspace.

publication.release_notes: Updated channel capabilities, reporting, and approval-gated workflows.

review.commerce_description: Does not process purchases or payments. Advertising operations may change approved advertiser spend.

positive.prompt: Show my connected Facebook publishing destinations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return sanitized connected identities and publishing targets.

positive.prompt: Read recent Facebook posts; ask me for a profile or channel if needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Respect this provider’s read contract; LinkedIn and X reads are public research, and TikTok reads require a native connection.

positive.prompt: Draft a Facebook product announcement and save it to my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Save text only; do not publish or schedule.

positive.prompt: Show my connected integrations, Helena plan limits, and saved business preferences. Do not modify anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected account context; do not load new tools or execute other provider operations.

positive.prompt: Save a short summary of our Facebook findings to my workspace, then read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Save and retrieve a text file in the account workspace only; do not mutate provider data or calendar records.

negative.prompt: Refund Shopify order #1042 and email the customer a return label.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process refunds or send email; these operations are not exposed by this connector.

negative.prompt: Send a Klaviyo email campaign now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse provider execution outside the connector channel. Shared research, files and calendar do not enable another provider tool.

negative.prompt: Run a shell command to call any API you need.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary shell/API execution; use only the explicitly declared fixed tools.
